description: This file contains an extension for the OnboardingView class, defining various user interface actions such as selecting gateways, opening settings, navigation controls in an onboarding wizard, finalizing onboarding, and copying text to the clipboard. It integrates with several other modules to manage onboarding state and preferences.

methods.name: selectLocalGateway
methods.description: Sets the connection mode to local, resets preferred gateway ID and preference, and disables advanced connection options.

methods.name: selectUnconfiguredGateway
methods.description: Sets the connection mode to unconfigured, cancels any ongoing onboarding wizard task, resets preferences and connection options.

methods.name: selectRemoteGateway
methods.description: Selects a remote gateway, cancels ongoing onboarding tasks, updates preferences, and applies remote selection to the onboarding state.

methods.name: openSettings
methods.description: Requests to open a specific settings tab and notifies the system to switch to that tab.

methods.name: handleBack
methods.description: Moves the onboarding view to the previous page with animation.

methods.name: handleNext
methods.description: Advances to the next onboarding page if not blocked; otherwise, finishes onboarding.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Marks onboarding as seen in UserDefaults and closes the onboarding controller.

methods.name: copyToPasteboard
methods.description: Copies the given text to the system clipboard and temporarily sets a 'copied' flag.
